v10 through a film-emulation pass

Three samples from TWO-LIGHTS-cut-v10.mp4, shown as paired frames. The pictures are embedded in this HTML; it works offline without external fonts, scripts, stylesheets, or image requests.

8.5 s27.0 s46.0 sstrength 0.85before / after
Research prototype, not a stock match. The pass adds luminance-scaled grain, soft warm halation, mild edge chromatic aberration, subpixel gate weave, slight radial distortion, vignette and a small black lift. Measurements below are content-dependent proxies, not photochemical calibration or an aesthetic rating.

Measurement definitions: residual grain SD and horizontal/vertical adjacent correlation are computed on a 1.2 px high-pass residual; highlight width is a local radial 10%-above-background falloff heuristic; edge acutance is mean Sobel gradient on the top 15% edge pixels; luma spread is P95−P05 in 8-bit luminance.

Source measurements and method: research/film_emulation/measurements.json and research/imaging-cut.md. The v10 source file was not changed.

All visual assets are embedded as JPEG data URIs. No network request is made by this page.
